evidence.quote: Ricky, them high-power rifles kin shoot three miles, and they don t make much noise a-tall. At this distance yuh wouldn t hear it a tall, sabe?
evidence.paraphrase: Zeb explains that high-power rifles can shoot three miles and produce little audible report at such distance.

evidence.quote: Giant powder!" exclaimed Zeb, sniffing the air. "Somebody done put dinnamite in our stove, Ricky!
evidence.paraphrase: The men discover their stove had been loaded with dynamite, destroying their camp.

evidence.quote:
Tent
s gone," he announced foolishly. "Good-by tent! Jerusalem! Zeb, our grub is all gone, too! Blewed up. Rifle gone, too
evidence.paraphrase: The explosion leaves them without tent, food, or rifle, changing their situation.

evidence.quote: Now mebby you fll agree with me that this ain fft no white man fs job, Ricky.
evidence.paraphrase: Zeb reacts to the destruction by declaring the job unfit for them.

evidence.quote: I got it all figgered out, Ricky. Them jaspers never walked over to th f party. It fs all of seven miles to th f nearest cow-camp.
evidence.paraphrase: Zeb reasons out the attackers' movements by deduction about distance and their likely method of arrival.
